meta.title: Petrichor Index item catalog
meta.source: Risk of Rain 2 Wiki structured item modules

items.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
items.summary: Deal extra damage to bosses.
items.exactEffect: Deal an additional 20% damage (+20% per stack) to bosses.

items.name: Backup Magazine
items.summary: Add an extra charge of your Secondary skill.
items.exactEffect: Add +1 (+1 per stack) charge of your Secondary skill.

items.name: Bison Steak
items.summary: Gain 25 max health.
items.exactEffect: Increases maximum health by 25 (+25 per stack).

items.name: Bolstering Lantern
items.summary: Increases your attack speed for every nearby enemy and ally.
items.exactEffect: Increase your attack speed by 10% (+3.5% per stack) for up to 3 (+1 per stack) enemies and allies within 20 meters.

items.name: Bundle of Fireworks
items.summary: Activating an interactable launches fireworks at nearby enemies.
items.exactEffect: Activating an interactable launches 8 (+4 per stack) fireworks that deal 300% base damage.

items.name: Bustling Fungus
items.summary: Heal all nearby allies after standing still for 1 second.
items.exactEffect: After standing still for 1 second, create a zone that heals for 4.5% (+2.25% per stack) of your health every second to all allies within 3m (+1.5m per stack).

items.name: Cautious Slug
items.summary: Rapidly heal outside of danger.
items.exactEffect: Increases base health regeneration by +3 hp/s (+3 hp/s per stack) while outside of combat.

items.name: Chronic Expansion
items.summary: Deal bonus damage for each enemy killed.
items.exactEffect: Killing an enemy increases your damage by 3.5% (+1% per stack), up to 10 (+5 per stack), for 7s. Dealing damage refreshes the timer.

items.name: Crowbar
items.summary: Deal bonus damage to enemies above 90% health.
items.exactEffect: Deal +75% (+75% per stack) damage to enemies above 90% health.

items.name: Delicate Watch
items.summary: Deal bonus damage. Breaks at low health.
items.exactEffect: Increase damage by 20% (+20% per stack). Taking damage to below 25% health breaks this item.

items.name: Eclipse Lite
items.summary: Gain a small temporary barrier when a skill comes off cooldown.
items.exactEffect: When a skill comes off cooldown, gain a temporary barrier for 1% (+0.25% per stack) of your maximum health per second of the skill's base cooldown.

items.name: Elusive Antlers
items.summary: Spawns orbs of energy that give bonus movement speed.
items.exactEffect: Spawns orbs of energy nearby every 10s (-10% per stack), giving +12% movement speed up to 3 (+3 per stack) times for 12s.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.summary: Increase sprint speed by +25%.
items.exactEffect: Sprint speed is improved by 25% (+25% per stack).

items.name: Focus Crystal
items.summary: Deal bonus damage to nearby enemies.
items.exactEffect: Increase damage to enemies within 13m by 20% (+20% per stack).

items.name: Gasoline
items.summary: Killing an enemy ignites other nearby enemies.
items.exactEffect: Killing an enemy ignites all enemies within 12m (+4m per stack) for 150% base damage. Additionally, enemies burn for 150% (+75% per stack) base damage.

items.name: Hiker's Boots
items.summary: Striking enemies from a higher elevation grants critical strike chance and damage.
items.exactEffect: Striking enemies from a higher elevation grants +1% (+1% per stack) critical strike chance and critical strike damage, up to 10 times. Lasts 10 seconds.

items.name: Item Scrap, White
items.summary: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with 3D Printers.
items.exactEffect: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with 3D Printers.

items.name: Lens-Maker's Glasses
items.summary: Gain 10% chance for hits to 'Critically Strike', dealing double damage.
items.exactEffect: Your attacks have a 10% (+10% per stack) chance to 'Critically Strike', dealing double damage.

items.name: Medkit
items.summary: Receive a delayed heal after taking damage.
items.exactEffect: 2 seconds after getting hurt, heal for 20 plus an additional 5% (+5% per stack) of maximum health.

items.name: Mocha
items.summary: Slightly increase attack speed and movement speed.
items.exactEffect: Increases attack speed by 7.5% (+7.5% per stack) and movement speed by 7% (+7% per stack).

items.name: Monster Tooth
items.summary: Drop a healing orb on kill.
items.exactEffect: Killing an enemy spawns a healing orb that heals for 8 plus an additional 2% (+2% per stack) of maximum health.

items.name: Oddly-shaped Opal
items.summary: Reduce damage the first time you are hit.
items.exactEffect: Increase armor by 100 (+100 per stack) while out of danger.

items.name: Paul's Goat Hoof
items.summary: Increase movement speed.
items.exactEffect: Increases movement speed by 14% (+14% per stack).

items.name: Personal Shield Generator
items.summary: Gain a recharging shield.
items.exactEffect: Gain a shield equal to 8% (+8% per stack) of your maximum health. Recharges outside of danger.

items.name: Power Elixir
items.summary: Receive an instant heal at low health. Consumed on use.
items.exactEffect: Taking damage to below 25% health consumes this item, healing you for 75% of maximum health.

items.name: Repulsion Armor Plate
items.summary: Receive flat damage reduction from all attacks.
items.exactEffect: Reduce all incoming damage by 5 (+5 per stack). Cannot be reduced below 1.

items.name: Roll of Pennies
items.summary: Gain gold on taking damage.
items.exactEffect: Gain 3 (+3 per stack) gold on taking damage from an enemy. Scales over time.

items.name: Rusted Key
items.summary: Gain access to a Rusty Lockbox that contains a powerful item.
items.exactEffect: A hidden cache containing an item (80%/20%) will appear in a random location on each stage. Opening the cache consumes this item.

items.name: Soldier's Syringe
items.summary: Increase attack speed.
items.exactEffect: Increases attack speed by 15% (+15% per stack).

items.name: Sticky Bomb
items.summary: Chance on hit to attach a bomb to enemies.
items.exactEffect: 5% (+5% per stack) chance on hit to attach a bomb to an enemy, detonating for 180% TOTAL damage.

items.name: Stun Grenade
items.summary: Chance to stun on hit.
items.exactEffect: 5% (+5% on stack) chance on hit to stun enemies for 2 seconds.

stacking.formula: Diminishing returns: coefficient × stacks / (1 + coefficient × stacks)

items.name: Topaz Brooch
items.summary: Gain a temporary barrier on kill.
items.exactEffect: Gain a temporary barrier on kill for 15 health (+15 per stack).

items.name: Tougher Times
items.summary: Chance to block incoming damage.
items.exactEffect: 15% (+15% per stack) chance to block incoming damage. Unaffected by luck.

stacking.formula: Diminishing returns: coefficient × stacks / (1 + coefficient × stacks)

items.name: Tri-Tip Dagger
items.summary: Gain +10% chance to bleed enemies on hit.
items.exactEffect: 10% (+10% per stack) chance to bleed an enemy for 240% base damage.

items.name: Warbanner
items.summary: Drop a Warbanner on level up or starting the Teleporter event. Grants allies attack and movement speed.
items.exactEffect: On level up or starting the Teleporter event, drop a banner that strengthens all allies within 16m (+8m per stack). Raise attack and movement speed by 30%.

items.name: Warped Echo
items.summary: Incoming damage is reduced and dealt over time.
items.exactEffect: The next source of damage is reduced by 10% and spread into 3 (+1 per stack) hits. All echoed damage is non-lethal except for the final hit. Recharges every 15s.

items.name: AtG Missile Mk. 1
items.summary: Chance to fire a missile.
items.exactEffect: 10% chance to fire a missile that deals 300% (+300% per stack) TOTAL damage.

items.name: Bandolier
items.summary: Chance on kill to drop an ammo pack that resets all skill cooldowns.
items.exactEffect: 18% (+10% per stack) chance on kill to drop an ammo pack that resets all skill cooldowns.

items.name: Berzerker's Pauldron
items.summary: Enter a frenzy after killing 4 enemies in quick succession.
items.exactEffect: Killing 4 enemies within 1 second sends you into a frenzy for 6s (+4s per stack). Increases movement speed by 50% and attack speed by 100%.

items.name: Box of Dynamite
items.summary: Your drones periodically drop dynamite.
items.exactEffect: Gain Lt. Droneboy. While in combat, your drones drop sticks of dynamite that detonate for 240% damage (+85% per stack), stunning enemies. Recharges after 10 seconds.

items.name: Breaching Fin
items.summary: Grounded enemies hit by any skill are launched and take bonus damage.
items.exactEffect: Grounded enemies hit with any skill are launched and stunned. Enemies hit while airborne are launched again up to 2 times (+1 per stack). Launched enemies take increased damage by 10% from all sources per launch.

items.name: Chance Doll
items.summary: Chance to increase item rarity at Shrines of Chance.
items.exactEffect: 40% (+10% per stack) chance to get higher rarity items from chance shrines on success.

items.name: Chronobauble
items.summary: Slow enemies on hit.
items.exactEffect: Slow enemies on hit for -60% movement speed for 2s (+2s per stack).

items.name: Collector's Compulsion
items.summary: Pickups grant a stacking bonus to all stats. Open a barrel to find a minor pick-up.
items.exactEffect: Picking up an item or other collectible increases all stats by +3% for 20 seconds, up to 3 (+2 per stack) times. Barrels grant minor pickups.

stacking.formula: 3% at 1 stack, no change each additional stack

stats.stat: Health, Health Regen, Movement Speed, Damage, Attack Speed, Crit Chance, Armor

items.name: Death Mark
items.summary: Enemies with 4 or more debuffs are marked for death, taking bonus damage.
items.exactEffect: Enemies with 4 or more debuffs are marked for death, increasing damage taken by 50% from all sources for 7 (+7 per stack) seconds.

items.name: Faraday Spur
items.summary: Moving around builds up movement speed and jump height. At 25% charge or higher, jump to discharge into an electric blast.
items.exactEffect: Moving around builds up charge, granting up to +160% movement speed and +200% jump height at 100%. At 25% charge or higher, jumping triggers an explosive discharge for 400% (+280% per stack) damage in a 5m to 32.3m (+7.5m per stack) area.

items.name: Fuel Cell
items.summary: Hold an additional equipment charge. Reduce equipment cooldown.
items.exactEffect: Hold an additional equipment charge (+1 per stack). Reduce equipment cooldown by 15% (+15% per stack).

items.name: Ghor's Tome
items.summary: Chance on kill to drop a treasure.
items.exactEffect: 4% (+4% on stack) chance on kill to drop a treasure worth $25. Scales over time.

items.name: Harvester's Scythe
items.summary: 'Critical Strikes' heal you.
items.exactEffect: Gain 5% critical chance. Critical strikes heal for 8 (+4 per stack) health.

items.name: Hopoo Feather
items.summary: Gain an extra jump.
items.exactEffect: Gain +1 (+1 per stack) maximum jump count.

items.name: Hunter's Harpoon
items.summary: Killing an enemy gives you a burst of movement speed.
items.exactEffect: Killing an enemy increases movement speed by 125%, fading over 1 (+0.5 per stack) seconds.

items.name: Ignition Tank
items.summary: Your ignite effects deal quadruple damage.
items.exactEffect: Ignite effects deal +300% (+300% per stack) more damage over time.

items.name: Infusion
items.summary: Killing an enemy permanently increases your maximum health, up to 100.
items.exactEffect: Killing an enemy increases your health permanently by 1 (+1 per stack), up to a maximum of 100 (+100 per stack) health.

items.name: Item Scrap, Green
items.summary: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with 3D Printers.
items.exactEffect: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with 3D Printers.

items.name: Kinetic Dampener
items.summary: Gain bonus armor while you have a shield. When shield breaks, release a stunning pulse that deals more damage the more shield you have.
items.exactEffect: Increases armor by 30 (+30 per stack) while you have a shield. When shield breaks, release a stunning pulse for 100% damage plus an amount equal to 100% (+10% per stack) of your max shield. Grants a shield for 4% of your max health.

items.name: Kjaro's Band
items.summary: High damage hits also blasts enemies with a runic flame tornado. Recharges over time.
items.exactEffect: Hits that deal more than 400% damage also blasts enemies with a runic flame tornado, dealing 300% (+300% per stack) TOTAL damage over time. Recharges every 10 seconds.

items.name: Leeching Seed
items.summary: Dealing damage heals you.
items.exactEffect: Dealing damage heals you for 1 (+1 per stack) health.

items.name: Lepton Daisy
items.summary: Periodically release a healing nova during the Teleporter event and 'Holdout Zones' such as the Void Fields.
items.exactEffect: Release a healing nova during the Teleporter event, healing all nearby allies for 50% of their maximum health. Occurs 1 (+1 per stack) times.

items.name: Luminous Shot
items.summary: Activating your Secondary skill charges your Primary skill with powerful lightning strikes. Requires 3 charges.
items.exactEffect: Activating Secondary skill stores up to 5 charges (+1 per stack). Requires 3 charges for your Primary skill to fire lightning strikes, dealing 175% TOTAL damage (+50% per stack) each. Reduces Secondary skill cooldown by 20%.

items.name: Noxious Thorn
items.summary: Killing an enemy transfers debuffs to a nearby enemy.
items.exactEffect: Gain 10% chance to bleed an enemy. On killing an enemy, transfer 33% of every debuff stack to 1 enemy (+1 per stack) within 20m (+5m per stack).

stacking.formula: Additional stacks do not change this effect

items.name: Old Guillotine
items.summary: Instantly kill low health Elite monsters.
items.exactEffect: Instantly kill Elite monsters below 13% (+13% per stack) health.

stacking.formula: Diminishing returns: coefficient × stacks / (1 + coefficient × stacks)

items.name: Old War Stealthkit
items.summary: Turn invisible at low health.
items.exactEffect: Falling below 25% health causes you to gain 40% movement speed and invisibility for 5s. Recharges every 30 seconds (-50% per stack).

stacking.formula: Each stack multiplies the remaining value

items.name: Prayer Beads
items.summary: Gains experience alongside you. Upon removal, grants bonus stats.
items.exactEffect: Grows by gaining experience, storing 20% (+5% per stack) bonus stats (health, regeneration, and damage). On removal, gain all stored stats.

items.name: Predatory Instincts
items.summary: 'Critical Strikes' increase attack speed. Stacks 3 times.
items.exactEffect: Gain 5% critical chance. Critical strikes increase attack speed by 12%. Maximum cap of 36% (+24% per stack) attack speed.

items.name: Razorwire
items.summary: Retaliate in a burst of razors on taking damage.
items.exactEffect: Getting hit causes you to explode in a burst of razors, dealing 160% damage. Hits up to 5 (+2 per stack) targets in a 25m (+10m per stack) radius

items.name: Red Whip
items.summary: Move fast out of combat.
items.exactEffect: Leaving combat boosts your movement speed by 30% (+30% per stack).

items.name: Regenerating Scrap
items.summary: Prioritized when used with Uncommon 3D Printers. Usable once per stage.
items.exactEffect: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with Uncommon 3D Printers. At the start of each stage, it regenerates.

items.name: Rose Buckler
items.summary: Reduce incoming damage while sprinting.
items.exactEffect: Increase armor by 30 (+30 per stack) while sprinting.

items.name: Runald's Band
items.summary: High damage hits also blasts enemies with runic ice. Recharges over time.
items.exactEffect: Hits that deal more than 400% damage also blasts enemies with a runic ice blast, slowing them by 80% for 3s (+3s per stack) and dealing 250% (+250% per stack) TOTAL damage. Recharges every 10 seconds.

items.name: Sale Star
items.summary: First chest bought yields more than one reward. Usable once per stage.
items.exactEffect: Gain an extra item on the first chest opened per stage. Each additional Sale Star increases the chance of getting more items by 5%.

items.name: Shipping Request Form
items.summary: Get a delivery each stage that contains powerful items.
items.exactEffect: A delivery containing 2 items (79%/20%/1%) will appear in a random location on each stage. (Increases rarity chances of the items per stack).

items.name: Shuriken
items.summary: Activating your Primary skill also throws a shuriken. Recharges over time.
items.exactEffect: Activating your Primary skill also throws a shuriken that deals 400% (+100% per stack) base damage. You can hold up to 3 (+1 per stack) shurikens which all reload over 10 seconds.

items.name: Squid Polyp
items.summary: Activating an interactable summons a Squid Turret nearby.
items.exactEffect: Activating an interactable summons a Squid Turret that attacks nearby enemies at 100% (+100% per stack) attack speed. Lasts 30 seconds.

items.name: Ukulele
items.summary: ...and his music was electric.
items.exactEffect: 25% chance to fire chain lightning for 80% TOTAL damage on up to 3 (+2 per stack) targets within 20m (+2m per stack).

items.name: Unstable Transmitter
items.summary: Gain a temporary barrier and a dimensional aura on low health.
items.exactEffect: Falling below 25% health gives you 60% of your maximum health as a temporary barrier. Gain a dimensional aura for 8s that bleeds and teleports away enemies. Enemies killed by the aura extend the duration by 1s. At the start of each stage, it regenerates.

items.name: War Horn
items.summary: Activating your Equipment gives you a burst of attack speed.
items.exactEffect: Activating your Equipment gives you +70% attack speed for 8s (+4s per stack).

items.name: Wax Quail
items.summary: Jumping while sprinting boosts you forward.
items.exactEffect: Jumping while sprinting boosts you forward by 10m (+10m per stack).

items.name: Will-o'-the-wisp
items.summary: Detonate enemies on kill.
items.exactEffect: On killing an enemy, spawn a lava pillar in a 12m (+2.4m per stack) radius for 350% (+280% per stack) base damage.

items.name: 57 Leaf Clover
items.summary: Luck is on your side.
items.exactEffect: All random effects are rolled +1 (+1 per stack) times for a favorable outcome.

items.name: Aegis
items.summary: Healing past full grants you a temporary barrier.
items.exactEffect: Healing past full grants you a temporary barrier for 50% (+50% per stack) of the amount you healed.

items.name: Alien Head
items.summary: Reduces cooldowns for your skills.
items.exactEffect: Reduce skill cooldowns by 25% (+25% per stack).

stacking.formula: Each stack multiplies the remaining value

items.name: Ben's Raincoat
items.summary: Prevent debuffs, instead gaining a temporary barrier. Recharges over time.
items.exactEffect: Prevents 1 (+1 per stack) debuff and instead grants a temporary barrier for 10% of maximum health. Recharges every 5 seconds.

items.name: Bottled Chaos
items.summary: Activating your Equipment triggers an additional, random Equipment effect.
items.exactEffect: Trigger a random equipment effect 1 (+1 per stack) time(s).

items.name: Brainstalks
items.summary: Skills have NO cooldowns for a short period after killing an elite.
items.exactEffect: Upon killing an elite monster, enter a frenzy for 4s (+4s per stack) where skills have 0.5s cooldowns.

items.name: Brilliant Behemoth
items.summary: All your attacks explode!
items.exactEffect: All your attacks explode in a 4m (+2.5m per stack) radius for a bonus 60% TOTAL damage to nearby enemies.

items.name: Ceremonial Dagger
items.summary: Killing an enemy releases homing daggers.
items.exactEffect: Killing an enemy fires out 3 homing daggers that deal 150% (+150% per stack) base damage.

items.name: Defensive Microbots
items.summary: Shoot down nearby projectiles. Recharge rate scales with attack speed.
items.exactEffect: Shoot down 1 (+1 per stack) projectiles within 20m every 0.5 seconds. Recharge rate scales with attack speed.

items.name: Dio's Best Friend
items.summary: Cheat death. Consumed on use.
items.exactEffect: Upon death, this item will be consumed and you will return to life with 3 seconds of invulnerability.

items.name: Electric Boomerang
items.summary: On hit chance to throw a stunning boomerang.
items.exactEffect: 15% chance on hit to fire an electric boomerang that travels a short distance before returning, dealing 120% (+120% per stack) damage and stunning all enemies hit. Also deals an additional 42% (+42% per stack) per second. Can strike enemies on the way back.

items.name: Frost Relic
items.summary: Killing enemies surrounds you with an ice storm.
items.exactEffect: Killing an enemy surrounds you with an ice storm that deals 1200% damage per second and slows enemies by 80% for 1.5s. The storm grows with every kill, increasing its radius by 2m. Stacks up to 18m (+12m per stack).

items.name: Growth Nectar
items.summary: Your buffs grant an increase to ALL of your stats.
items.exactEffect: Grants 4% increase to ALL stats for each buff, up to a maximum of 4 (+4 per stack).

stacking.formula: 4% at 1 stack, no change each additional stack

stats.stat: Health, Health Regen, Movement Speed, Damage, Attack Speed, Crit Chance, Armor

items.name: H3AD-5T v2
items.summary: Increase jump height. Hold 'Interact' to slam down to the ground.
items.exactEffect: Increase jump height. Creates a 5m-100m radius kinetic explosion on hitting the ground, dealing 1000%-10000% base damage that scales up with fall distance. Recharges in 10 (-50% per stack) seconds.

stacking.formula: Base value divided by the stack factor

recipes.note: The two ingredients must be different.

items.name: Happiest Mask
items.summary: Chance on killing an enemy to summon a ghost.
items.exactEffect: Killing enemies has a 7% chance to spawn a ghost of the killed enemy with 1500% damage. Lasts 30s (+30s per stack).

items.name: Hardlight Afterburner
items.summary: Add 2 extra charges of your Utility skill. Reduce Utility skill cooldown.
items.exactEffect: Add +2 (+2 per stack) charges of your Utility skill. Reduces Utility skill cooldown by 33%.

items.name: Interstellar Desk Plant
items.summary: Plant a healing fruit on kill.
items.exactEffect: On kill, plant a healing fruit seed that grows into a plant after 5 seconds. The plant heals for 5% of maximum health every 0.5 second to all allies within 10m (+5.0m per stack). Lasts 10 seconds.

items.name: Item Scrap, Red
items.summary: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with 3D Printers.
items.exactEffect: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with 3D Printers.

items.name: Laser Scope
items.summary: Your 'Critical Strikes' deal an additional 100% damage.
items.exactEffect: Critical Strikes deal an additional 100% damage (+100% per stack).

items.name: N'kuhana's Opinion
items.summary: Fire haunting skulls when healed.
items.exactEffect: Store 100% (+100% per stack) of healing as Soul Energy. After your Soul Energy reaches 10% of your maximum health, fire a skull that deals 250% of your Soul Energy as damage.

items.name: Networked Suffering
items.summary: Inflict a computer virus on hit that spreads a portion of all damage dealt between infected enemies. Affects up to 4 enemies.
items.exactEffect: Infect up to 4 (+2 per stack) enemies with a computer virus that duplicates 45% of all damage taken and sends it to a global damage pool. Every 3 seconds, ALL infected enemies suffer 100% pooled damage.

items.name: Orphaned Core
items.summary: Gain a buddy who launches itself at enemies to deal damage. Inherits your movement-related items.
items.exactEffect: Gain a friendly Solus unit that launches itself at enemies for 400% (+400% per stack). The unit inherits your movement speed items and deals more damage the faster it moves. The unit can be pet to cleanse negative effects. Recharges after 15 seconds.

items.name: Pocket I.C.B.M.
items.summary: All Missile items deal more damage and fire an additional two missiles.
items.exactEffect: All missile items and equipment fire an additional 2 missiles. Increase missile damage by 0% (+50% per stack).

items.name: Rejuvenation Rack
items.summary: Double the strength of healing.
items.exactEffect: Heal +100% (+100% per stack) more.

items.name: Resonance Disc
items.summary: Obtain a Resonance Disc charged by killing enemies. Fires automatically when fully charged.
items.exactEffect: Killing 4 enemies in 7 seconds charges the Resonance Disc. The disc launches itself toward a target for 300% base damage (+300% per stack), piercing all enemies it doesn't kill, and then explodes for 1000% base damage (+1000% per stack). Returns to the user, striking all enemies along the way for 300% base damage (+300% per stack).

items.name: Runic Lens
items.summary: Chance to call down a meteor. Damage and chance are increased with higher damage hits.
items.exactEffect: 3% chance on hit to call down a meteor, dealing 2000% base damage. Every 100% attack damage dealt increases the activation chance by 3% (+3% per stack) and damage by 150% (+50% per stack).

items.name: Sentient Meat Hook
items.summary: Chance to hook all nearby enemies.
items.exactEffect: 20% (+20% per stack) chance on hit to fire homing hooks at up to 10 (+5 per stack) enemies for 100% TOTAL damage.

stacking.formula: Diminishing returns: coefficient × stacks / (1 + coefficient × stacks)

items.name: Shattering Justice
items.summary: Reduce the armor of enemies after repeatedly striking them.
items.exactEffect: After hitting an enemy 5 times, reduce their armor by 60 for 8 (+8 per stack) seconds.

items.name: Sonorous Whispers
items.summary: Upon large or elite monster kill chance to drop items.
items.exactEffect: When a large monster is killed it will always drop an item. All elites have a 5% chance of dropping an item (+1% per item stack).

items.name: Soulbound Catalyst
items.summary: Kills reduce equipment cooldown.
items.exactEffect: Kills reduce equipment cooldown by 4s (+2s per stack).

items.name: Spare Drone Parts
items.summary: Your drones fire faster, have less cooldowns, shoot missiles, and gain a bonus chaingun.
items.exactEffect: Gain Col. Droneman. Drones gain +25% (+25% per stack) attack speed and cooldown reduction. Drones gain 10% chance to fire a missile on hit, dealing 150% TOTAL damage. Drones gain an automatic chain gun that deals 6x50% damage, bouncing to 2 enemies.

items.name: Substandard Duplicator
items.summary: Picking up an item grants a temporary copy.
items.exactEffect: Picking up an item gives you a temporary copy of itself. Temporary items last an additional 10 (+10 per stack) seconds

items.name: Symbiotic Scorpion
items.summary: Permanently reduce armor on hit.
items.exactEffect: 100% chance on hit to reduce armor by 2 (+2 per stack) permanently.

items.name: Unstable Tesla Coil
items.summary: Shock all nearby enemies every 10 seconds.
items.exactEffect: Fire out lightning that hits 3 (+2 per stack) enemies for 200% base damage every 0.5s. The Tesla Coil switches off every 10 seconds.

items.name: Wake of Vultures
items.summary: Temporarily steal the power of slain elites.
items.exactEffect: Gain the power of any killed elite monster for 8s (+5s per stack).

items.name: War Bonds
items.summary: Bombard boss events with missiles. The more gold earned, the more UES support is granted.
items.exactEffect: During boss events, 5 missiles bombard the area, dealing 2.5% (+2.5 per stack) of bosses' Max Health in damage. Before the boss event, gain additional missiles, up to a maximum of 20 (+5 per stack), per 50 gold gained. Gold requirement scales with time.

stacking.formula: 2.5% Max Health at 1 stack, +2.5% each additional stack

items.name: Artifact Key
items.summary: A stone shard with immense power.
items.exactEffect: A stone shard with immense power.

items.name: Charged Perforator
items.summary: Chance on hit to call down a lightning strike.
items.exactEffect: 10% chance on hit to down a lightning strike, dealing 500% (+500% per stack) damage.

items.name: Defense Nucleus
items.summary: Summon an Alpha Construct on killing an elite.
items.exactEffect: Killing elite monsters spawns an Alpha Construct with bonus 300% damage and 300% health. Limited to 4 (+4 per stack).

items.name: Empathy Cores
items.summary: Recruit a pair of Solus Probes that gain power with more allies.
items.exactEffect: Every 30 seconds, summon two Solus Probes that gain +100% (+100% per stack) damage per ally on your team.

items.name: Encrypted Cerebellum
items.summary: Contains encrypted remnants of the Collective network. Needs to be decrypted.
items.exactEffect: Contains encrypted remnants of the Collective network. Needs to be decrypted before it can be returned.

items.name: Exposed Cerebellum
items.summary: A swarming data nexus representing the Collective network. Can be given to a powerful entity.
items.exactEffect: A swarming data nexus representing the Collective network. Can be given to a powerful entity.

items.name: Faulty Conductor
items.summary: Occasionally release a pulse of electricity that energizes allies and makes enemies more susceptible to electric damage.
items.exactEffect: Every 15 (-20% per stack) seconds, release a wave of electricity that energizes nearby allies for 7 seconds. Energized allies gain +30% attack and movement speed, and ALWAYS land critical strikes with electric items and attacks.

stacking.formula: Diminishing returns: coefficient × stacks / (1 + coefficient × stacks)

items.name: Functional Coupler
items.summary: Holds an additional equipment.
items.exactEffect: Hold 1 additional equipment (+1 per stack). Press the interact and equipment buttons to cycle through held equipment.

items.name: Genesis Loop
items.summary: Fire an electric nova at low health.
